title: urlSync for pages doesn't work with numericSelector and Pagination
body:
Hi

I am trying to implement instantsearch on an app. I have everything work as expected except that the urlSync doesn't work for keeping the current page. It works for everything else and only works as expected when I remove my numericSelectors.

You can test this by using the tourism example in the docs and enabling urlSync, changing pages and refreshing takes you back to the first page.

Any suggestions?
